title: Explainable AI and Ethics
lead: Covers: the black-box problem, the goals of explainable AI (trust, debugging, fairness and auditing), the accuracy-interpretability trade-off, glass-box models, global vs local explanations, permutation importance, LIME and SHAP with worked numbers, the nine ethical foundations of using (Gen)AI, the EU AI Act (risk levels, duties, general-purpose AI, fines) and how to approach the EU case-analysis assignment. No prior lecture attendance needed.
